cozum: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'
yanlis: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name <> 'hedef'

cozum: SELECT siparis_id, adet * birim_fiyat AS tutar FROM siparis WHERE iade = 'hayır' ORDER BY tutar DESC, siparis_id LIMIT 3
yanlis: SELECT siparis_id, adet * birim_fiyat AS tutar FROM siparis ORDER BY tutar DESC, siparis_id LIMIT 3
SELECT siparis_id, adet * birim_fiyat AS tutar FROM siparis WHERE iade = 'hayır' ORDER BY tutar, siparis_id LIMIT 3

cozum: SELECT siparis_id, CASE WHEN indirim_orani IS NULL THEN 'bilinmiyor' WHEN indirim_orani = 0 THEN 'yok' WHEN indirim_orani < 0.10 THEN 'dusuk' ELSE 'yuksek' END AS indirim_sinifi FROM siparis
yanlis: SELECT siparis_id, CASE WHEN indirim_orani = 0 THEN 'yok' WHEN indirim_orani < 0.10 THEN 'dusuk' ELSE 'yuksek' END AS indirim_sinifi FROM siparis

cozum: SELECT SUM(adet * birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(indirim_orani, 0))) AS net_ciro FROM siparis
yanlis: SELECT SUM(adet * birim_fiyat * (1 - indirim_orani)) AS net_ciro FROM siparis

cozum:
uygun = [s for s in siparisler if s['iade'] == 'hayır']
sonuc = sum(s['adet'] * s['birim_fiyat'] for s in uygun) / len(uygun)
yanlis: sonuc = sum(s['adet'] * s['birim_fiyat'] for s in siparisler) / len(siparisler)

cozum: SELECT urun, COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi, SUM(adet) AS toplam_adet FROM siparis GROUP BY urun HAVING SUM(adet) >= 5
yanlis: SELECT urun, COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi, SUM(adet) AS toplam_adet FROM siparis GROUP BY urun HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4

cozum: SELECT m.musteri_id, m.segment FROM musteri m LEFT JOIN siparis s ON s.musteri_id = m.musteri_id WHERE s.siparis_id IS NULL
yanlis: SELECT m.musteri_id, m.segment FROM musteri m JOIN siparis s ON s.musteri_id = m.musteri_id WHERE s.siparis_id IS NULL

cozum: SELECT h.ay, h.hedef_ciro, COALESCE(SUM(s.adet * s.birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(s.indirim_orani, 0))), 0) AS gerceklesen, COALESCE(SUM(s.adet * s.birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(s.indirim_orani, 0))), 0) - h.hedef_ciro AS fark FROM hedef h LEFT JOIN siparis s ON substr(s.tarih, 1, 7) = h.ay GROUP BY h.ay, h.hedef_ciro
yanlis: SELECT h.ay, h.hedef_ciro, SUM(s.adet * s.birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(s.indirim_orani, 0))) AS gerceklesen, SUM(s.adet * s.birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(s.indirim_orani, 0))) - h.hedef_ciro AS fark FROM hedef h JOIN siparis s ON substr(s.tarih, 1, 7) = h.ay GROUP BY h.ay, h.hedef_ciro
